description: Defines the BandwidthSampler class and related structures for tracking bandwidth and congestion control in QUIC protocol, including bandwidth sampling, acknowledgment height tracking, and connection state management.

classes.name: MaxAckHeightTracker
classes.description: Tracks the maximum acknowledgment height (ack aggregation) in bandwidth sampling.

classes.name: BandwidthSamplerInterface
classes.description: Interface for bandwidth sampling classes, providing methods for packet sent/lost events and congestion event processing.

classes.name: BandwidthSampler
classes.description: Implements bandwidth sampling for QUIC, tracking sent and acknowledged packets, estimating bandwidth, and managing app-limited phases.

classes.name: AckPoint
classes.description: Represents a point on the acknowledgment timeline, including acknowledgment time and total bytes acknowledged.

classes.name: RecentAckPoints
classes.description: Maintains the two most recent acknowledgment points at distinct times for bandwidth estimation.

classes.name: ConnectionStateOnSentPacket
classes.description: Stores connection state information at the time a packet was sent, used for bandwidth calculations.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates the max acknowledgment height based on bandwidth estimate, acknowledgment timing, and packet numbers.

methods.name: SetFilterWindowLength
methods.description: Sets the window length for acknowledgment height filtering.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets acknowledgment height tracking to a new height and time.

methods.name: SetAckAggregationBandwidthThreshold
methods.description: Sets the bandwidth threshold for acknowledgment aggregation.

methods.name: SetStartNewAggregationEpochAfterFullRound
methods.description: Configures whether to start a new acknowledgment aggregation epoch after a full round.

methods.name: SetReduceExtraAckedOnBandwidthIncrease
methods.description: Configures whether to reduce extra acknowledged bytes on bandwidth increase.

methods.name: IsOverestimateAvoidanceEnabled
methods.description: Checks if overestimate avoidance is enabled.

methods.name: OnPacketSent
methods.description: Records a sent packet event into the bandwidth sampler.

methods.name: OnCongestionEvent
methods.description: Processes acknowledgment and loss events to update bandwidth estimates.

methods.name: OnAckEventEnd
methods.description: Finalizes bandwidth estimation after acknowledgment events.

methods.name: RemoveObsoletePackets
methods.description: Removes packets below a certain packet number from tracking.

methods.name: is_app_limited
methods.description: Indicates if the connection is currently app-limited.

methods.name: end_of_app_limited_phase
methods.description: Returns the packet number marking the end of the current app-limited phase.
